# Route 53

Manage hosted zones and record sets without running a DNS server.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `route53` |
| Signing name | `route53` |
| Wire protocol | REST XML |
| API version | `2013-04-01` |
| Scope | Account-wide |
| Execution | Records only |
| Selected operations | 21 of 71 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#route-53) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- No DNS listener and no endpoint probing for health checks.
- No traffic policies, reusable delegation sets, query logging, DNSSEC or CIDR collections.
- The console edits simple and existing routing-policy records but cannot choose a new routing policy, associate VPCs with an existing zone or edit health checks.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.
